description: This is a PHP unit test class for the PimReportDataAPI class, specifically testing the 'getAll' method and some validation/error scenarios within the 'orangehrmPimPlugin'. It sets up test data, mocks API interactions, and ensures proper exception handling for unimplemented methods.

classes.name: PimReportDataAPITest
